study type: Nationwide, register-based case-control study with a sibling comparison analysis
cohort: The study included 5612 individuals with AS matched with 22,042 controls without inflammatory arthritis from the general population, and a sibling comparison involving 3965 AS patients and 6070 siblings without spondyloarthritis.
finding: Having older siblings and a history of tonsillectomy in childhood were independently associated with the development of ankylosing spondylitis, even after adjusting for family-shared factors.
